info.title: POP — Payment Ops Platform API (mock contract)
info.description:
API contract for the POP mock in the FSB Payment Ops demo — scoped to the single endpoint Pega calls: **threshold determination**.

POP handles email work internally against the real mailboxes via **Outlook / Microsoft Graph APIs** (FIS exception-email intake and RBO/PCG reply parsing), so those are not part of this HTTP contract. After parsing, POP calls the Pega mock's own API — `POST /api/cases` to create cases (one per company/ACH ID per file) and `POST /api/cases/{id}/submit` to post parsed RBO/PCG decisions — both specified in the Pega mock's `openapi.json` (served at http://localhost:3000/api-docs).

POP is **headless** (no operator UI) and **stateless** (no storage beyond a transaction). All data is fictional; both apps are demo mocks.

servers.description: POP mock (suggested port — must not collide with the Pega mock on 3000)

post.summary: Determine routing for an exception (called by Pega's workflow)
post.description:
The core POP call in the case workflow. Receives the full exception payload upfront (per the headless/stateless design — data is shifted left into the request), computes **Overage = Exposure − D.Limit − C.Limit** (for the highest transaction) and the **grand total** (PCG hold — credits only), compares the overage against the temporary threshold, and returns the routing determination synchronously:
- overage = 0 → `EQUALS_LIMIT` / route `HUMAN_REVIEW`
- 0 < overage ≤ temp threshold → `BELOW_THRESHOLD` / route `AUTO_CLOSE_BELOW_THRESHOLD`
- overage > temp threshold → `EXCEEDS_THRESHOLD` / route `RBOPCG_ESCALATION`

Pega records the request and response as history lines and applies the routing.

example.rationale: Overage $50,000.00 exceeds temporary threshold $25,000.00 — RBO/PCG escalation required

tempValue.description: Temporary limit increase (0 = none on file)

grandTotalValue.description: Sum of overages for the PCG hold — credits only (null for debit exposure)
